acs.text: Requesting a published book detail page that does not exist returns an HTTP 404.

exercises.rationale: The successful detail-page inspection explicitly covers the published-via package statement on an existing book page.
The successful detail-page inspection explicitly covers the package-name link on an existing book page.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the presence of the title on the book page.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the author line in the required `by <author>` form.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed genre.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed `Rating: <n>` value.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed book format.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed valid ISBN-13.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed publication month and year.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed blurb.
The successful detail-page inspection covers the displayed cover image.
The CTA navigation journey activates the `Publish your book like this one` call to action and proves its `/publish` destination.
The missing-book error journey proves the path-specific 404 outcome.

judgements.rationale: The missing-book 404 behavior is public and visible to any visitor, so user-reach applies. The source does not indicate money, auth, or data-loss risk for this promise.
